original: Publicly accessible 7kw EV charging points are located at Millers Dale Station and Parsley Hay. Traditional fuel stations are found in gateway towns like Buxton and Glossop outside the park boundary.
translated: Öffentlich zugängliche 7kw EV Ladepunkte befinden sich an Millers Dale Station und Parsley Hay. Traditionelle Tankstellen finden sich in Torstädten wie Buxton und Glossop außerhalb der Parkgrenze.
